props.gloss_en: the collapse of which they spoke is of sound [walls], not shaky ones -- those not fit to fall, not those fit to fall
it is needed for walls that fell because of their height
alternatively, walls standing on a riverbank
the shaky wall in Nehardea under which Rav and Shmuel would not pass, though it had stood in place thirteen years
Shmuel to Rav: come, Master, let us go around
Rav: it is not needed today, for Rav Adda bar Ahava is with us, whose merit is great, and I am not afraid
Rav Huna brought Rav Adda bar Ahava into the shaky house and kept him in a halakhic discussion until the wine was removed; after they left the house fell
Rav Adda bar Ahava realised and was angry
the stam: Rav Adda holds in accordance with R' Yannai's dictum
R' Yannai: a person should never stand in a place of danger and say 'a miracle will be done for me', lest no miracle be done for him
R' Yannai: and if a miracle is done for him, it is deducted from his merits
Rav Chanan: what is the verse? 'I am diminished by all the kindnesses and all the truth' (Gen 32:11)
the stam: Rav Adda's deeds [behind his great merit] are those he reported when asked how he lengthened his days
Rav Adda: in all my days I was not angry within my house
and I did not walk ahead of one greater than me
and I did not meditate [on Torah] in filthy alleys
and I did not walk four cubits without Torah and without tefillin
and I did not sleep in the study hall, neither a fixed sleep nor a nap
and I did not rejoice at my fellows' stumbling
and I did not call my fellow by his nickname
variant: ...by his [derogatory] surname
Rafram: his youth I do not remember; his old age I remember
on every cloudy day they would take him out in a golden carriage, he would survey the whole town, and tear down every shaky wall
if its owner could, he rebuilt it; if not, Rav Huna rebuilt it from his own
every Sabbath-eve afternoon he sent a messenger to the market, bought all the vegetables left to the gardeners and threw them in the river
[Rav Huna] holds: human food is not fed to animals
when he had a medicine he filled a jug with it, hung it on his doorpost and said: whoever wants, let him come and take
variant: he knew a remedy against shivta; he set out a jug of water and hung it up, saying: whoever needs, let him come in [and wash] so as not to be endangered
when he ate bread he opened his doors and said: whoever needs, let him come and eat
Rava: all of them I can fulfil, except this one, which I cannot do
Rava: because the soldiers of Mechoza are many
Ilfa and R' Yochanan, hard-pressed: let us go and trade, and fulfil in ourselves 'however there shall be no needy among you' (Deut 15:4)
the first angel: let us throw this wall on them and kill them, for they leave eternal life and occupy themselves with temporal life
the other angel: leave them, for there is one among them whose hour stands before him
R' Yochanan: since I heard and Ilfa did not, learn from it that it is my hour that stands
R' Yochanan: I will go back and fulfil in myself 'for the needy shall not cease from the land' (Deut 15:11)
R' Yochanan went back, Ilfa did not; by the time Ilfa came, R' Yochanan had become head
they said to Ilfa: had the Master sat and studied, would the Master not have become head?
Ilfa, hanging from the ship's mast: if anyone asks me about a baraita of R' Chiyya and R' Oshaya and I do not resolve it from our mishnah, I fall from the mast and drown
one who says 'give a shekel to my sons each week', and they are fit to be given a sela -- they are given a sela
and if he said 'give them only a shekel' -- they are given only a shekel
if he said 'if they die, others inherit in their place' -- whether he said 'give' or 'give only' -- they are given only a shekel
Ilfa: whose is this? It is R' Meir's
R' Meir, who said: it is a mitzva to fulfil the words of the dead
they said of Nachum Ish Gam Zu that he was blind in both eyes, without both hands and both legs, his whole body full of boils, and lay in a shaky house
Nachum: clear the vessels first and then my bed, for you are assured that as long as I am in the house the house does not fall
they cleared the vessels and then his bed, and the house fell
his students: Rabbi, since you are wholly righteous, why has this befallen you?
Nachum: my sons, I brought it on myself -- a poor man asked me for food on the road, I told him to wait until I unloaded the donkey, and before I had unloaded his soul left him

Nachum: I fell on his face and said: may my eyes that had no pity on your eyes be blinded, my hands be cut off, my legs be cut off; my mind did not rest until I said: may my whole body be full of boils
his students: woe to us that we have seen you so
Nachum: woe to me had you not seen me so
why was he called Nachum Ish Gam Zu? because of everything that befell him he would say: this too is for good
the Jews: who will go? let Nachum Ish Gam Zu go, for he is accustomed to miracles
the king, wishing to kill them all: the Jews are mocking me
Nachum: this too is for good

Elijah: perhaps this dust is from the dust of their father Abraham, who threw dust and it became swords, stubble and it became arrows, as it is written 'he makes his sword as dust, his bow as driven stubble' (Isa 41:2)
a province they could not conquer: they tried the dust and conquered it; they filled his chest with jewels and sent him with great honour
Nachum to the innkeepers: what I took from here I brought there
they tested [the innkeepers' dust] and did not find it so, and killed those innkeepers

nodes.label_he: אמרו עליו על נחום איש גם זו שהיה סומא משתי עיניו, גידם משתי ידיו, קיטע משתי רגליו, וכל גופו מלא שחין, והיה מוטל בבית רעוע
nodes.label_en: they said of Nachum Ish Gam Zu that he was blind in both eyes, without both hands and both legs, hi…

nodes.label_he: פנו את הכלים ואחר כך פנו את מטתי, שמובטח לכם שכל זמן שאני בבית אין הבית נופל
nodes.label_en: Nachum: clear the vessels first and then my bed, for you are assured that as long as I am in the ho…

nodes.label_he: פינו את הכלים ואחר כך פינו את מטתו, ונפל הבית
nodes.label_en: they cleared the vessels and then his bed, and the house fell

nodes.label_he: רבי, וכי מאחר שצדיק גמור אתה, למה עלתה לך כך?
nodes.label_en: his students: Rabbi, since you are wholly righteous, why has this befallen you?

nodes.label_he: בניי, אני גרמתי לעצמי ... בא עני אחד ... אמרתי לו: המתן עד שאפרוק מן החמור. לא הספקתי לפרוק מן החמור עד שיצתה נשמתו
nodes.label_en: Nachum: my sons, I brought it on myself -- a poor man asked me for food on the road, I told him to…

nodes.label_he: עיני שלא חסו על עיניך -- יסומו, ידיי ... יתגדמו, רגלי ... יתקטעו. ולא נתקררה דעתי עד שאמרתי: כל גופי יהא מלא שחין
nodes.label_en: Nachum: I fell on his face and said: may my eyes that had no pity on your eyes be blinded, my hands…

nodes.label_he: אוי לנו שראינוך בכך
nodes.label_en: his students: woe to us that we have seen you so

nodes.label_he: אוי לי אם לא ראיתוני בכך
nodes.label_en: Nachum: woe to me had you not seen me so

nodes.label_he: ואמאי קרו ליה נחום איש גם זו -- דכל מילתא דהוה סלקא ליה, אמר: גם זו לטובה
nodes.label_en: why was he called Nachum Ish Gam Zu? because of everything that befell him he would say: this too i…

nodes.label_he: מאן ייזיל -- ייזיל נחום איש גם זו, דמלומד בניסין הוא
nodes.label_en: the Jews: who will go? let Nachum Ish Gam Zu go, for he is accustomed to miracles

nodes.label_he: קא מחייכו בי יהודאי
nodes.label_en: the king, wishing to kill them all: the Jews are mocking me

nodes.label_he: אמר: גם זו לטובה
nodes.label_en: Nachum: this too is for good

nodes.label_he: דלמא הא עפרא מעפרא דאברהם אבוהון הוא, דכי הוה שדי עפרא -- הוו סייפי, גילי -- הוו גירי, דכתיב: יתן כעפר חרבו כקש נדף קשתו
nodes.label_en: Elijah: perhaps this dust is from the dust of their father Abraham, who threw dust and it became sw…

nodes.label_he: הויא חדא מדינתא דלא מצו למיכבשה, בדקו מיניה וכבשוה ... ושדרוהו ביקרא רבה
nodes.label_en: a province they could not conquer: they tried the dust and conquered it; they filled his chest with…

nodes.label_he: מאי דשקלי מהכא אמטי להתם
nodes.label_en: Nachum to the innkeepers: what I took from here I brought there

nodes.label_he: בדקוה ולא אשכחוה, וקטלינהו להנך דיוראי
nodes.label_en: they tested [the innkeepers' dust] and did not find it so, and killed those innkeepers

nodes.label_he: ולתיביה לעניים
nodes.label_en: ולתיביה לעניים! -- let him give them to the poor

nodes.label_he: זמנין דסמכא דעתייהו ולא אתו למיזבן
nodes.label_en: זמנין דסמכא דעתייהו ולא אתו למיזבן -- at times they would rely on it and not come to buy

nodes.label_he: ולשדייה לבהמה
nodes.label_en: ולשדייה לבהמה! -- let him throw them to animals

nodes.label_he: קסבר: מאכל אדם אין מאכילין לבהמה
nodes.label_en: קסבר: מאכל אדם אין מאכילין לבהמה (= p_maachal_adam_libhema, attributed to Rav Huna)

nodes.label_he: ולא ליזבניה כלל
nodes.label_en: ולא ליזבניה כלל! -- then let him not buy them at all

nodes.label_he: נמצאת מכשילן לעתיד לבא
nodes.label_en: נמצאת מכשילן לעתיד לבא -- you would be found to make them stumble in the future

nodes.label_he: סבר לה כי הא דאמר רבי ינאי ... מנכין לו מזכיותיו
nodes.label_en: סבר לה כי הא דאמר רבי ינאי ... מנכין לו מזכיותיו -- a miracle done for him is deducted from his mer…

nodes.label_he: אמר רב חנן: מאי קרא
nodes.label_en: אמר רב חנן: מאי קרא -- דכתיב קטנתי מכל החסדים ומכל האמת

nodes.label_he: מאי הוה עובדיה דרב אדא בר אהבה? כי הא דאתמר
nodes.label_en: מאי הוה עובדיה דרב אדא בר אהבה? כי הא דאתמר -- the deeds behind the great merit Rav relied on
